notes.title: Relayer Advanced: Function for gamepad button locations
notes.content:
We’ve received many requests regarding the operation method in Relayer Advanced and will initially implement a modification function for the initial allocation of the gamepad buttons on Nov. 14th (JST). We’ll be working on the keyboard and controller button configs. and the button guide displays as well in the future. We look forward to your continuing support for Relayer Advanced.
DRAGAMI GAMES

(How to initially set up your gamepad buttons)

1. Select Type X or Type Y from “Options” in the game.
You can also change the select button to “Down” or “Right”(Please refer to the first image right below).

notes.title: Relayer Advanced System
notes.content:
There are various systems you can use of in Relayer Advanced.
Use and increase your "Hate" parameter to attract and lure your enemies attacks towards your heavly defensive unit(s) as a battle tactic to win your battles. You can also increase your gauge and timely launch your "Big Bang" attacks to inflict destructive damage to your enemies. Relayer Advanced is coming on Oct 27 (12 mid JST),

notes.title: Relayer Advanced Features: New End Content
notes.content:
A high-level mission, the "Wormhole Mission" consisting of 5 stages has been added in Relayer Advanced. It's more difficult than the "Asterism Voyage" but players can clear this mission on the easy mode. There are some unique rewards obtainable in this new end content so look forward to playing this mission! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43072386/b7775bbc40a1c32b67045cbcdbfe67efaedd46da.png[/img]

notes.title: Relayer Advanced Features: Recollection Function
notes.content:
Players can always go back and see view the events in the adventure part by utlizing the "Recollection Function"in Relayer Advanced.  Go to "Space Science Library" and go to "Recollections" to browse these:)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43072386/bdc5992857f0067eac214a42b9eee507c44b3849.png[/img]

notes.title: Relayer Advanced Features: "Luminous Line"
notes.content:
The battle UI for Relayer Advance has been significantly improved by adding the Luminous Lines to easily see the movement and attack ranges from your battle units on the battle map.
Players can switch to the orhodox grids or the new Luminous Lines on the option screen.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43072386/806189f9701f527984e636abd93995f32cab29f2.png[/img]

notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Our newly enhanced SRPG title, “Relayer Advanced” is slated to be released on October 27th at 12 midnight JST.

Don’t miss out on the new features the new UI and “Luminous Line”, “Recollection Feature” to see the adventure parts anytime, and end content, “Wormhole Mission” with 5 new stages!
Stay tuned in for more from “Relayer Advanced” and Dragami Games.
